description: This Python source file defines a specialized configuration class for DeepSeek's chat completion API. It extends an OpenAI GPT configuration class to support DeepSeek-specific parameters and message transformation. It includes methods for mapping parameters, transforming messages, obtaining API URLs, and supporting specific features relevant to DeepSeek's chat completion service.
